denial.falsifier: Any declaration-list edit (count, storage class, scope, order) inside HealthMeterStart that moves `stwu r1,-136(r1)` off 136 — the denial rests on two byte-invariant probes, not on a score.
denial.premise_measurement: slotdiff after the keep: `frame: target 128 ours 136  saves: target r21 ours r21`, and the ONLY referenced local slot in either stream is 36 (buf, 4 uses in both) plus the save/restore slots (target 76, ours 84). The surplus is therefore 8 bytes of UNREFERENCED nominal reservation sitting above buf. Two probes moved it zero: `register int num; register int i;` and moving `i` out of the function scope into a block inside `if (flag != 0)` plus a bare block around the second loop. Both reproduced the identical --ops output verbatim (T113/O113, 2 clusters at @0x40/@0x48, the same 7 IMMEDIATE rows including `stwu r1,-136`, `stmw r21,84`, `stfd f31,128`).
denial.scope: The DECLARATION-STORAGE-CLASS and BLOCK-SCOPE axes on the surviving 8-byte local-area surplus of src/game/boss/boss.c::HealthMeterStart ONLY (frame target 128 vs ours 136, save base 76 vs 84, buf at r1+36 in both streams). It does NOT deny the remaining `mr`-vs-`addi` copy rows and it does NOT deny a compensating-pair or region-arithmetic attack on the frame.

held_fixed: Every probe held the function's statement structure, its declaration list and the .rodata BYTE LAYOUT constant (coin[3][12]=0..35, errFmt[28]=36..63, bgFmt=64..79, fgFmt=80..95 before and after the split) and varied exactly one construct: (1) the ternary's condition polarity, (2) a (char*) cast on the sprintf format argument, (3) whether bgFmt/fgFmt are members of sBossStr or their own static const char[16] objects at the same offsets.

hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: `fnasm game/boss/boss HealthMeterStart 0x0:0x20 --diff` plus the target's f31 store offset: if the target ALSO reserves an 8-byte area for `v` and simply places it below the save area rather than above buf, the surplus is a region-ORDER difference, not a reservation difference, and no declaration edit will close it.
hypothesis.screened_against_target: no — the parameter-home theory has not been checked against the target's prologue; what IS screened is that neither stream references any local slot other than buf (36) in the whole body.
hypothesis.statement: The 8-byte surplus is NOT declaration-count-driven (register and block-scope both measured byte-invariant), so the next candidate is the f32 parameter `v`: it is the only value in this function that is both a PARAMETER and FPR-resident (f31 is saved in both streams), and an 8-byte nominal reservation is exactly the size of a double-width parameter home. Probe whether retyping or re-homing `v` (e.g. reading it once into a declared f32 local as the first statement, per claim.law.CT_a-saved-parameter-numbers-below-the-locals-until-you-give-it-a-declared-copy.20260903.v1) moves the save base from 84 to 76.
